column3: requireActorActive (actor_active.go, #4159) reads only the acting user's own account row, not state of the secret SetSecretCertNotAfter writes, so it is an actor-authority check. The write only caches the certificate's expiry and its error is ignored. A stale pass equals inspect-then-suspend, a legal serial order; the check only narrows what the function allowed before #4159. Covers this check only.
